p.i: Illius at sæpe impotens Procella mersis nauibus Ponit modum cupidini.
Terris relictis ad suos Fugere cælos Veritas Fideíque: Cuncta Pontifex, Cohorsque Cardinalium Passim gubernant: hoc fluunt Prognata fonte tot mala.
Vbique cuncta Turcicum Domare cerno militem: Canum cateruas & suum Vbique denso confpicor Mersas voluptabro sequi Erroris atri dogmata.
Sunt rura plena & oppida Nefariorum cœtibus, Audaciumque hostilia Monere bella Numini: Quorum furentes dexteras Supreme Iudex obtere.
O, bruta corda Plebium! Mortalium, ò, demens furor, Suique nescius mali! O, terra cadium appetens! O, terra semper ebria Innoxiorum sanguine!

page.notes: Printed page number "178" at top right, set in larger type. Marginal ink marks and stains are not transcribed. Some letters in the verse are worn (e.g. "Cuncta", "obtere", "cadium") and may be misprinted; the final mark after "obtere" and "sanguine" is a printed sign, rendered as punctuation. The stanza-initial and line-final letters "conspicor" and "Pontifex" are read from a worn impression and should be checked.
